This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their pair of [[Tooth|tusks]] and [[Color|tan]] skin.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Maudie-Brady-Tusked-Mask.png|thumb|left|250px|Maudie Brady working on the original mask for this species]]
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], in [[5 BBY]], a member of this species visited the [[Caleen Salyard]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], interacting with at least one of the employees, [[Timm Karlo]].<ref name="Episode">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> In [[3 BBY]], another member of this species could be found on the planet [[Coruscant]], leaving a [[Samo's|corner market]] as [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and [[Bix Caleen]] entered.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman?">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> Much later, in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> yet another member of this species attended the [[Aki-Aki]] [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on [[Pasaana]], being present when [[Rey Skywalker]] and company arrived on their [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|mission]] to track down a [[Sith wayfinder]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard-64.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wizard 64 by Luke Fisher]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> The concept art for this species was created by concept artist and sculptor [[Luke Fisher]],<ref name="Concept">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> while the character mask was sculpted by artist [[Maudie Brady]].<ref name="Bust">{{HomeVideoCite|film=9|featurette=Cast of Creatures}}</ref><ref name="Brady">{{WebCite|url=https://maudiebrady.com/star-wars-episode-ix-the-rise-of-skywalker|text=Star Wars Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker|work=[https://maudiebrady.com/ Maudie Brady Art]|archivedate=20241213043659}}</ref>
